items.title: fix(android): reduce repeated retries to unreachable gateways (#138732)
items.summary: fix(android): reduce repeated retries to unreachable gateways (#138732) Keep transient retries fast, then use a finite 30–60s jittered retry timer. Wake the existing ladder on manual or independent LAN/VPN attachment events, without retiring healthy READY sockets or resuming auth-paused sessions. Include desired secondary sessions in the same recovery path. Related: #127872 Prior investigation: #127873 (closed; no prior proof reused). AI-assisted implementation and validation. Worked on by: - @IWhatsskill Co-authored-by: IWhatsskill
